person.name: Helmut Chaparro Sandoval

profile: Multidisciplinary technology and engineering professional with 6+ years of cumulative experience designing, building and leading end-to-end solutions across software engineering, backend/full-stack development, data and analytics, AI/ML, embedded systems, IoT, electronics, robotics, automation, biomedical-oriented prototyping and technical product delivery. Hands-on experience with C#/.NET, Python, SQL, REST APIs, JavaScript/TypeScript, SQL Server, systems integration, data modeling and transformation workflows, dashboards, telemetry, real-time acquisition, firmware, sensors, PCB and FPGA technologies. Founder and technical leader experienced in requirements, solution architecture, product roadmaps, multidisciplinary teams, technical documentation, stakeholder communication, implementation and operational execution. Strong systems-thinking approach that connects software, data, AI and physical devices into practical products and decision-support solutions. English B2 used professionally across all roles; French B2 applied in IEEE leadership environments and basic Mandarin Chinese (HSK2) applied in Arisoft contexts.
